title.en: Weigh a choice with a friend
title.es: Sopesar una decisión con un amigo

es: Aconsejar a un amigo ante una decisión difícil con hipótesis sobre pasado y presente (If I were you…, If you had…) y responder a sus dudas.

teaching.en: The choice is hard, so I want to weigh the pros and cons.
teaching.es: La elección es difícil, así que quiero sopesar los pros y los contras.
teaching.explanationEs: Weigh = sopesar; pros and cons = ventajas y desventajas.
segments: The choice is hard, so I want
to weigh the pros and cons.
teaching.audioText: The choice is hard, so I want to weigh the pros and cons.

teaching.en: If I were you, I would accept the offer. Honestly, it's a good chance.
teaching.es: Yo en tu lugar aceptaría la oferta. Sinceramente, es una buena oportunidad.
teaching.explanationEs: If I were you, I would + verbo base: consejo sobre el presente.
segments: If I were you, I would accept
the offer. Honestly, it's a good chance.
teaching.audioText: If I were you, I would accept the offer. Honestly, it's a good chance.

teaching.en: Don't worry about the past. If you had waited, you would be in the same place now.
teaching.es: No te preocupes por el pasado. Si hubieras esperado, estarías en el mismo sitio ahora.
teaching.explanationEs: Hipótesis mixta: pasado irreal (had waited) y efecto presente (would be).
segments: Don't worry about the past. If you had waited,
you would be in the same place now.
teaching.audioText: Don't worry about the past. If you had waited, you would be in the same place now.

teaching.en: A stable job is safer but, on the other hand, it is less exciting in the long run.
teaching.es: Un trabajo estable es más seguro, pero por otro lado es menos emocionante a la larga.
teaching.explanationEs: On the other hand compara; in the long run mira al futuro lejano.
segments: A stable job is safer but, on the other
hand, it is less exciting in the long run.
teaching.audioText: A stable job is safer but, on the other hand, it is less exciting in the long run.

teaching.en: I advise you not to rush. If I were you, I would sleep on it.
teaching.es: Te aconsejo que no te precipites. Yo en tu lugar lo consultaría con la almohada.
teaching.explanationEs: Advise + you + not to + verbo; sleep on it = pensarlo una noche.
segments: I advise you not to rush. If I
were you, I would sleep on it.
teaching.audioText: I advise you not to rush. If I were you, I would sleep on it.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo aconsejas a un amigo con «si yo fuera tú» sobre mudarse a un piso nuevo?

choices.text: If I am you, I would move to the new flat.
If I would be you, I move to the new flat.
If I were you, I would move to the new flat.

feedback.es: «Si yo fuera tú» se dice If I were you, y el consejo lleva would + verbo base.

hint.es: Para el consejo se usa were, también con I, y would + verbo base.

prompt.es: Completa: «No te precipites con la decisión. Piénsalo con calma.»

feedback.es: Rush = precipitarse: Don't rush the decision.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa hacer algo con demasiada prisa.

origin.text: Don't ___ the decision. Sleep on it.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por otro lado, a la larga un trabajo estable es más seguro.»

answer.text: On the other hand, in the long run a stable job is safer.

feedback.es: On the other hand compara dos ideas; in the long run mira al futuro lejano.

hint.es: Las dos expresiones con coma van al principio.

prompt.es: Elige la opinión de un amigo sobre esa decisión pasada de Mia.

choices.text: If I were you, I would have stayed.
If I were you, I would stay.
If I am you, I would have stayed.

feedback.es: Para opinar sobre una decisión ya tomada se usa If I were you, I would have + participio.

origin.text: Mia: I accepted the job in Rome, but I never see my family now.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión de consejo con su significado.

feedback.es: Estas expresiones suavizan el consejo, comparan opciones o piden tiempo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dificultad tiene la persona.

choices.text: She must choose between more money and being close to her family.

feedback.es: Duda entre más dinero y estar cerca de la familia: esa es la dificultad de su elección.

origin.audio: I have two offers. One pays more, but the other one is closer to my family. I can't decide.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la decisión de Leo con su situación actual.

choices.text: If Leo takes the job, he won't live near his parents.
If Leo had taken the job, he wouldn't have lived near his parents.
If Leo had taken the job, he wouldn't live near his parents now.

feedback.es: No tomó el trabajo (pasado) y vive cerca de sus padres (presente): had + participio y would + verbo base con now.

origin.text: Leo didn't take the job in Berlin. Now he lives in the same town as his parents.

prompt.es: Reescribe con inversión, sin if: «If I had known, I would have helped you.»

answer.text: Had I known, I would have helped you.
accepted: Had I known, I would have helped you.
Had I known I would have helped you.

feedback.es: Para la inversión se quita if y se coloca had antes del sujeto: Had I known…

origin.text: If I had known, I would have helped you.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace hoy la mujer que dejó el banco.

choices.text: She works with children and feels proud.
She earns more at the bank.
She is looking for a new job.

feedback.es: El efecto actual es lo que dice de hoy: trabaja con niños y está orgullosa; ganar más era la alternativa.

origin.audio: I left my job at a bank last year. If I had stayed, I would be earning more, but I would be stressed. Today I work with children, and I'm proud of my choice.

prompt.es: Aconseja a un amigo con If I were you y una hipótesis sobre hoy. Unas 55 palabras.

answer.text: You have two choices. The stable job is safer, but the job abroad is more exciting. If you had stayed here last year, you would be with your family now. On the other hand, if you take the job abroad, you will learn a lot. If I were you, I would take the job abroad. Honestly, I advise you not to rush. Sleep on it!
accepted: You have two choices. The stable job is safer, but the job abroad is more exciting. If you had stayed here last year, you would be with your family now. On the other hand, if you take the job abroad, you will learn a lot. If I were you, I would take the job abroad. Honestly, I advise you not to rush. Sleep on it!

Your choice is hard. The stable job is safer, but the other one is abroad. If you had accepted the first offer last year, you would be working here now. On the other hand, you would miss the chance to travel. If I were you, I would take the job abroad because you love travelling. Don't rush, though. Sleep on it.

You have to weigh the pros and cons. The job abroad pays more, but you would live far from your family. If you had waited, you would be in the same place now. Honestly, if I were you, I would sleep on it. In the long run, a stable job is safer, so I advise you not to rush.

feedback.es: Un buen consejo describe las dos opciones, añade una hipótesis mixta (If you had… you would be… now), da el consejo con If I were you, I would… y lo razona.

origin.text: Un amigo duda entre un trabajo estable y otro en el extranjero. Describe sus dos opciones con una consecuencia de cada una, plantea una hipótesis sobre su vida de hoy si hubiera decidido otra cosa el año pasado y aconséjale con If I were you. Unas 55 palabras.

prompt.es: Completa: «Te aconsejo que no te precipites.»

feedback.es: Tras advise + persona, la negación va con not to + verbo: not to rush.

choices.text: She would be happier at the bank.
She would be earning more at the bank.

feedback.es: Ana dice que en el banco ganaría más ahora; pero es feliz con su decisión.

origin.text: Ana: I quit my job at the bank. If I had stayed, I would be earning more now. But I'm happy.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector de efecto o causa con su sentido.

feedback.es: Conectan la decisión con su efecto: as a result y that's why dan el resultado; thanks to, la causa.
